d: Overhealing adds +1 max HP (up to +10 per run).
fl: It wastes nothing, least of all mercy.

d: +3 DEF per copy while above 80% HP.
fl: Tall walls, short memory.

d: +1 DEF; enemy hits land 1 lighter per copy while you're below half HP.
fl: Old iron protects old wounds.

d: Pays 20 gold at each floor's gate for +4 DEF that floor. Can't pay? It stays shut.
fl: Protection has a price. It collects.
pas: 20g per floor → +4 DEF; dormant if unpaid.

d: From your 2nd strike each fight: +1 bleed damage per copy.
fl: The first cut is just an introduction.

d: Every kill notches +1 ATK this floor per copy.
fl: One line carved for every name.

d: +4 ATK — shatters forever the first time you fall.
fl: Beautiful, sharp, and honest about it.

d: Your opening strike each fight hits +2 per copy.
fl: Round one. Ding.

d: Your first attack gauge each fight starts 30% filled.
fl: The charge answers before the call ends.

d: Fights won in 6 strikes or fewer heal 2 per copy.
fl: Finish fast, breathe easy.

d: +10 [[LCK]] in boss fights.
fl: It points at what wants you dead.

d: Your first crit each floor: +8 [[LCK]] that floor.
fl: Bit down on a miracle once.
nat: Fires on your first crit each floor.

d: 10% flat chance per copy (max 20%) enemy attacks simply miss.
fl: The knot unties itself. Elsewhere.

d: Your thorn reflections also shake loose 2 gold per copy.
fl: Even its cruelty is ornamental.

d: Death recovers 65% of your purse instead of 50%.
fl: Sewn shut. Mostly.

d: The first relic effect each fight is doubled.
fl: It answers before you finish asking.

d: Chains decay gently (×0.75), but the chain cap drops.
fl: Brighter. Longer. Narrower.

d: Every fight also activates one random relic you carry.
fl: It passes the message along. Loudly.

d: Catches a fizzled chain; your next strike releases it for 2 damage.
fl: Nothing wasted. Nothing forgiven.

d: Deep chains (depth 3+) hum back 1 healing.
fl: It hums along with the violence.

d: Your awakened relics count as three copies.
fl: One more turn of the screw.

d: Speed surges arc 1 damage per copy to the enemy.
fl: The wind here has teeth.

d: +3 ATK; enemy hits land +1 harder.
fl: Heavy is the head. And dented.

d: Each of your turns costs 3 gold; when it collects, heal 1 per copy.
fl: It pays you in your own blood, laundered.

d: Gold gained by relics buys back 1 flesh per copy.
fl: Every coin weighed in meat.
nat: Fires when a relic pays out.

d: Relic damage mints 1 gold per copy off your armor.
fl: The plate keeps what the blow paid.
nat: Fires when a relic deals damage.

d: Gold gained by relics decays into a tainted 1-heal per copy.
fl: Even rot pays rent.
nat: Fires when a relic pays out.

d: +40 gold now; -2 ATK until 60 gold is earned back.
fl: The links are shaped like promises.
